_comment: Constitutive classification of the benchmark sources, used to build the
generality matrix. Each entry records the source feature the class was read
from, so the classification can be checked against the code rather than
taken on trust. Structural facts -- source form, file count, helper
routines, include files, dimensions, existing tangent -- are NOT declared
here: the matrix derives those from the sources and contracts directly.

m1_elastic.classified_from: DDSDDE built from two Lame constants; no yield surface or state

m2_cubic.classified_from: three independent stiffness constants C11, C12, C44

m2_elastic3d.classified_from: full 3D isotropic stiffness, no inelastic branch

m3_j2.classified_from: EQPLAS state and a Mises yield check drive a radial return

m5_cpflow.classified_from: GDOT activation-energy flow rule solved by a local Newton iteration on DEQPL

m6_fcc.classified_from: Schmid factors over slip systems with per-system GDOT

sweep_aniso_ortho.classified_from: 13 independent DDSDDE assignments, nine engineering constants

sweep_damage_elastic.classified_from: stiffness scaled by a damage variable carried in STATEV

sweep_drucker_prager.classified_from: Drucker-Prager yield with a pressure term

sweep_eco.classified_from: reduced elastic model from the ECO archive source

sweep_j2_bilinear.classified_from: EQPLAS with a constant plastic modulus

sweep_j2_combined.classified_from: back stress ALPHA plus isotropic EQPLAS hardening

sweep_j2_kinematic.classified_from: back stress ALPHA with no isotropic term

sweep_lame_elastic.classified_from: Lame parameterisation of the elastic stiffness

sweep_maxwell_ve.classified_from: Maxwell branch relaxed over DTIME; the only model with a helper subroutine

sweep_mooney_small.classified_from: Mooney-Rivlin constants in a small-strain stiffness

sweep_perzyna_linear.classified_from: rate-dependent overstress divided by a viscosity

sweep_thermoelastic.classified_from: thermal expansion ALPHA times DTEMP subtracted from the strain increment

sweep_transiso.classified_from: 13 DDSDDE assignments with a single symmetry axis
